digest.component_or_area: LLM structured output routing and error classification (Bedrock/Anthropic provider integration)
propositions: A model capability row enabling native_structured_output for sonnet-4-6 (added 2026-08-05 00:48) causes rebar to send Bedrock a JSON Schema for constrained decoding that exceeds Anthropic's 180-second grammar-compilation timeout and 24-optional-parameter complexity cap

Plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite_verify and code-review LLM-Review gate both fail with HTTP 400 ValidationException when verification contracts (22-36 optional parameters) are sent as native output, degrading all findings to no-verification and producing unsigned INDETERMINATE verdicts

Output mode selection must gate NativeOutput on both stack support (outputConfig parameter availability) and measured schema complexity bounds (16 optional / 12 union parameters), not only on capability records, to prevent sending compilable-grammar requests to providers that cannot fulfill them

Schema-complexity rejections must be classified distinctly from provider outages and surface the model and contract names to operators, enabling fallback to PromptedOutput rather than silent or opaque failure
